variety_description: High yielding, medium maturity, short slender grain, blast resistant variety developed by PJTSAU, Hyderabad. Released in 2014 for transplanted irrigated lowland areas of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.  Recommended for cultivation in both kharif and rabi seasons. Good cooking and eating quality. Low glycemic index.
